docs.text: Lupines are one of my favorite wildflowers. They spring up triumphantly in dense groups of purple and pink, standing tall above the grass. I love to see them in the springtime on the shores of Lake Superior in northern Wisconsin. I hope you enjoy! LUPINES, Acrylic, 16x16” ©2026 Jim Musil
